source: create a game where users cam fly all kinds of vehicles & they will get points after hitting the CP written boards on various similar looking buildings.

answers.ask: No theme was stated - modern city, military airfield, or something stylized?
answers.answer: Use a small modern city with similar-looking buildings and rooftop/side checkpoint boards.

answers.ask: Is this a timed score attack, a race between players to the highest score, or endless free flight?
answers.answer: Make it endless free flight: players earn points whenever they hit checkpoint boards, with their score tracked on a leaderboard.

config.prompt: create a game where users cam fly all kinds of vehicles & they will get points after hitting the CP written boards on various similar looking buildings.
config.genre_evidence: Players "fly all kinds of vehicles" and earn points by hitting "CP" boards placed around buildings, implying a checkpoint-based vehicle course.
config.evidence: No explicit start/end, closed loop, or above/below course crossings are stated; "fly" supports an open play volume and "CP" boards support checkpoint detection.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Racing map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Point to Point: A course that starts in one place and ends in another — downhill, drag, sprint, single-swimmer.

INCLUDE:
- Open Play Volume: Racing through a volume rather than across a surface — swimming lanes, flight circuits.
